description: In a well-order of uncountable cofinality, the successor points are unbounded and are not ordinal-closed.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.successors_unbounded_not_closed.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsUnbounded (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.successorPoints α) ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.IsOrdinalClosed (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.successorPoints α)
